failure_reason: Akamai bot wall was defeated by a real Chrome browser tier (mcp__claude-in-chrome) after direct-HTTP was fully blocked in the prior pass -- genuine category and listing pages rendered with real product grids and counts. However this browser session shares a heavily contended Chrome instance with many other concurrent extraction tasks (tabs kept getting reassigned/closed mid-task), and after roughly 20 rapid sequential navigations to homedepot.com, the site started returning its own client-side 'Error Page' / 'Oops!! Something went wrong' interstitial on every URL, including ones that had rendered correctly minutes earlier (e.g. Bathroom Mirrors) -- a behavioral rate-limit/soft-throttle, not a hard 403. Extraction was stopped at that point rather than retried in a loop, per the no-backoff/no-polling rule. A meaningful set of real Bath subcategory leaves were captured before the throttle began.
notes: SR197 The Home Depot. Browser tier (claude-in-chrome) succeeded where curl_cffi/direct-HTTP had failed in the prior pass: real Bath taxonomy loaded from https://www.homedepot.com/b/Bath/N-5yc1vZbzb3 (16 nav entries). Home Depot's Bath hierarchy mixes genuine sub-categories with heavily overlapping cross-cutting facets (e.g. Vanities: 'by width' vs 'by With/Without Tops' vs 'by Single/Double Sink' all describe the SAME vanity set from different angles; Bathtubs: installation-type facet vs therapy-type facet likewise overlap; Toilets: shape/height/flush/piece-count are all facets of one set). Per rule 29 (ambiguity -> LOW confidence -> review, never guess) those pure-hub nodes with only overlapping facet children and no own product grid -- Bathroom Vanities (core cabinets), Bathroom Faucets (core), Showers (core hub), Bathtubs (core hub), Toilets (core) -- were NOT recorded as rows; only their genuinely distinct, non-overlapping child product types that rendered their own real product grid were recorded (Vanity Tops, Shower Doors, Shower Heads, Toilet Seats, Bidets). Bathroom Sinks, Bathroom Accessories, Bathroom Exhaust Fans, and Bathroom Safety root pages rendered as empty/thin templates (banner only, no grid, no sub-links) on repeated reload -- reproducible, not a one-off load glitch -- so no data existed to record; logged to review. Shower Pans and Shower Stalls & Kits returned Home Depot's own client-side Error Page consistently before any grid loaded. Shower Curtains (721 results) correctly excluded from Bathroom rows per rule 20 (Bathroom Curtains -> Textile) and logged to review. Cross-category dedup checked for every candidate URL against cross_category_url_index.json -- no collisions, nothing already extracted elsewhere. Session-wide rate-throttle began after ~20 navigations (previously-good Mirrors URL started erroring too), so remaining nodes (Steam Showers, Shower Walls & Surrounds, Shower Enclosures/Bathtub Doors subsets, Bathroom Cabinets subset of Storage, Tub & Shower Combos) were not reached -- status is partial, not blocked, since real non-fabricated data was recovered and the access method (browser tier) is proven to work for this site going forward.
